privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: Sticker Swap Hub ("we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

dataCollected.title: Data We Collect
dataCollected.body: When you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email address, and profile picture from your Google account. We also store the sticker collection data you enter (which stickers you own and how many duplicates you have).

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Data
howWeUse.body: Your data is used solely to provide the service: storing your sticker collection, generating your public profile link, and enabling collection comparisons with other users. We do not sell your data to third parties.

publicProfile.title: Public Profile
publicProfile.body: Your collection is accessible via a public link using your chosen username. Anyone with the link can view your stickers to compare collections. Your email address is never publicly visible.

cookies.title: Cookies & Sessions
cookies.body: We use session cookies to keep you signed in. No third-party advertising cookies are used.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.body: You may delete your account at any time. Upon deletion, all your personal data and collection information is permanently removed from our systems.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For any privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@stickersawphub.com.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: By using Sticker Swap Hub you agree to these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully.

service.title: The Service
service.body: Sticker Swap Hub provides a digital tool to track sticker collections for the FIFA World Cup 2026 Panini album and to facilitate sticker trades between users. The service is provided free of charge.

account.title: Your Account
account.body: You must sign in with a valid Google account. You are responsible for all activity under your account. Your chosen username must not impersonate others or contain offensive language.

userContent.title: User Content
userContent.body: Collection data you enter belongs to you. By making your profile public, you grant other users read access to your sticker list for comparison purposes.

conduct.title: Acceptable Use
conduct.body: You agree not to abuse, disrupt, or attempt to gain unauthorized access to the service. Automated scraping or bulk data extraction is prohibited.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: Sticker Swap Hub is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with FIFA, Panini, or any official World Cup partner. All team names, player names, and tournament trademarks belong to their respective owners.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: The service is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We are not liable for any loss of data, missed trades, or indirect damages arising from use of the service.

changes.title: Changes to These Terms
changes.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For questions about these terms, contact us at legal@stickersawphub.com.
